entries.subject: Color
entries.finding: A black body at the 2,956 K dayside brightness temperature measured in secondary eclipse at 4.5 µm (Deming et al. 2023, dayside brightness temperature at 4.5 µm (uniform reanalysis of Spitzer's eclipses, CDS J/AJ/165/104 table 2)): #ffb66a.
